concerns.text: Task T019.1 validates SART Mean RT within a 'lower-bound-defined window up to 3000ms', contradicting FR-009 which mandates validation of the full range '100ms - 5000ms'. This silently relaxes the upper-bound constraint, allowing slow outliers to pass the pilot check.

Tasks T012 and T012.1 generate recruitment documentation (protocol/script) which is not required by any Functional Requirement (FR-001 to FR-011). Furthermore, T019.1 (the FR-009 pilot check) depends on these unproduced docs, creating a circular dependency that prevents the mandatory pre-study validation from running, violating the spec's requirement to validate the system before recruitment.

Task T033.1 states 'FOLLOWING PLAN OVERRIDE: Wilcoxon fallback triggered ONLY on convergence failure, NOT Shapiro-Wilk p-value'. However, FR-006 explicitly mandates: 'triggered only if Shapiro-Wilk p < 0.05'. The task description overrides the spec requirement without a corresponding spec amendment, constituting a silent weakening of the functional requirement.

Task T038.2 only implements the 'limitation statement' branch for missing objective data. It lacks a concrete implementation task for the 'if available' branch of FR-011 (compare self-reported logs against objective screen-time data), leaving the core comparison logic of the requirement unimplemented.
